notes: os-upgrade-project now writes .claude/settings.json (Claude Code hooks) alongside the existing .antigravity/.gemini/.agents hooks.json (Antigravity/Gemini format) — the two were never the same mechanism, so downstream projects migrated by this script previously got dead Claude Code hooks, mirroring the gap PR #5 fixed locally. New step [4/7] deploys .agents/hooks/{reground,precompact-snapshot}.sh and gitignores the generated snapshot. E2E tested: fresh project, unrelated-existing-settings.json preserved (not clobbered), idempotent re-run verified byte-identical.
